items.verseEn: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.

items.verse: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِيَسْكُنُوا۟ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ
items.verseEn: Do they not see that We made the night that they may rest therein and the day giving sight? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -
And made of him two mates, the male and the female.

items.verse: وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلْيَتَـٰمَىٰٓ أَمْوَٰلَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا تَتَبَدَّلُوا۟ ٱلْخَبِيثَ بِٱلطَّيِّبِ ۖ وَلَا تَأْكُلُوٓا۟ أَمْوَٰلَهُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَمْوَٰلِكُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ حُوبًۭا كَبِيرًۭا
items.verseEn: And give to the orphans their properties and do not substitute the defective [of your own] for the good [of theirs]. And do not consume their properties into your own. Indeed, that is ever a great sin.

items.verse: قُلْ إِن ضَلَلْتُ فَإِنَّمَآ أَضِلُّ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِى ۖ وَإِنِ ٱهْتَدَيْتُ فَبِمَا يُوحِىٓ إِلَىَّ رَبِّىٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ سَمِيعٌۭ قَرِيبٌۭ
items.verseEn: Say, "If I should err, I would only err against myself. But if I am guided, it is by what my Lord reveals to me. Indeed, He is Hearing and near."
So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

items.verse: وَإِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ ۖ لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
items.verseEn: And your god is one God. There is no deity [worthy of worship] except Him, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

categories.name: مُفْرَدَاتٌ مِنْ قِصَّةِ مُوسَى وَالْخَضِرِ فِي سُورَةِ الْكَهْفِ
categories.nameEn: Key terms from the story of Musa and Khidr in Surah Al-Kahf

items.verse: فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَا قَالَ لِفَتَىٰهُ ءَاتِنَا غَدَآءَنَا لَقَدْ لَقِينَا مِن سَفَرِنَا هَـٰذَا نَصَبًۭا
items.verseEn: So when they had passed beyond it, [Moses] said to his boy, "Bring us our morning meal. We have certainly suffered in this, our journey, [much] fatigue."

items.verse: وَكَيْفَ تَصْبِرُ عَلَىٰ مَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِۦ خُبْرًۭا
items.verseEn: And how can you have patience for what you do not encompass in knowledge?"

items.verse: قَالَ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ صَابِرًۭا وَلَآ أَعْصِى لَكَ أَمْرًۭا
items.verseEn: [Moses] said, "You will find me, if Allāh wills, patient, and I will not disobey you in [any] order."

items.verse: وَأَمَّا ٱلْغُلَـٰمُ فَكَانَ أَبَوَاهُ مُؤْمِنَيْنِ فَخَشِينَآ أَن يُرْهِقَهُمَا طُغْيَـٰنًۭا وَكُفْرًۭا
items.verseEn: And as for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared that he would overburden them by transgression and disbelief.

categories.name: قِصَّةُ سُلَيْمَانَ وَمَلِكَةِ سَبَأٍ
categories.nameEn: Key Objects in the Story of Solomon and the Queen of Sheba

items.verse: ٱذْهَب بِّكِتَـٰبِى هَـٰذَا فَأَلْقِهْ إِلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا يَرْجِعُونَ
items.verseEn: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then leave them and see what [answer] they will return."

items.verse: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ قَالَ أَتُمِدُّونَنِ بِمَالٍۢ فَمَآ ءَاتَىٰنِۦَ ٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌۭ مِّمَّآ ءَاتَىٰكُم بَلْ أَنتُم بِهَدِيَّتِكُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ
items.verseEn: So when they came to Solomon, he said, "Do you provide me with wealth? But what Allāh has given me is better than what He has given you. Rather, it is you who rejoice in your gift.

items.verse: ٱرْجِعْ إِلَيْهِمْ فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّهُم بِجُنُودٍۢ لَّا قِبَلَ لَهُم بِهَا وَلَنُخْرِجَنَّهُم مِّنْهَآ أَذِلَّةًۭ وَهُمْ صَـٰغِرُونَ
items.verseEn: Return to them, for we will surely come to them with soldiers that they will be powerless to encounter, and we will surely expel them therefrom in humiliation, and they will be debased."

items.verse: قَالَ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ أَيُّكُمْ يَأْتِينِى بِعَرْشِهَا قَبْلَ أَن يَأْتُونِى مُسْلِمِينَ
items.verseEn: [Solomon] said, "O assembly [of jinn], which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?"

harf.hint: Said as a greeting between Muslims; one of Allah's beautiful names
harf.arabicVerse: فَٱصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَـٰمٌۭ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
harf.verse: 43:89 - So turn aside from them and say, "Peace." But they are going to know.

deduction.title: The Trusted Spirit of Revelation
deduction.intro: In the unseen realms, a being of pure light moves with precision, executing every command without hesitation. This figure has spoken to chosen servants, brought words of guidance, and witnessed the unfolding of divine decrees across the ages. Who is this honored soul?
clues: I am a being of pure light, created from light, and I have never disobeyed a single command of my Lord.
I move between the heavens and the earth, descending with the decrees of the Most Merciful.
I was sent to a noble virgin in the sanctuary, announcing to her a pure son.
I am the spirit of holiness, and I supported a prophet who was given clear signs and the Gospel.
I came to a cave on a mountain to deliver the first words of a recitation that would be preserved forever.
I am the trustworthy spirit, and it was I who brought the Quran down upon the heart of the final messenger.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Harut (one of the two angels in Babylon)

trial.label: Key Mission/Role
options: Blowing the trumpet on the Day of Judgment

outcome.label: Outcome of the Mission
options: The Quran was revealed to Prophet Muhammad
The trumpet was blown on the Day of Judgment
Hell was guarded and its gates were closed
The Book of Deeds was presented to Allah
The rain was sent down to the earth
outcome.answer: The Quran was revealed to Prophet Muhammad

deduction.verse: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger [i.e., Gabriel] (81:19)

translations: Lodge them from where you dwell (out) of your means
and (do) not harm them to distress [on] them And if they are
those (who are) pregnant then spend on them until
they deliver their burden Then if they suckle for you
then give them their payment and consult among yourselves with kindness
but if you disagree then may suckle for him another (women)
scramble.hint: A powerful reminder of the believer's responsibility to safeguard themselves and their families from the Hellfire, whose fuel are people and stones.
scramble.arabic: أَسْكِنُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ سَكَنتُم مِّن وُجْدِكُمْ وَلَا تُضَآرُّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُوا۟ عَلَيْهِنَّ ۚ وَإِن كُنَّ أُو۟لَـٰتِ حَمْلٍۢ فَأَنفِقُوا۟ عَلَيْهِنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ ۚ فَإِنْ أَرْضَعْنَ لَكُمْ فَـَٔاتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ ۖ وَأْتَمِرُوا۟ بَيْنَكُم بِمَعْرُوفٍۢ ۖ وَإِن تَعَاسَرْتُمْ فَسَتُرْضِعُ لَهُۥٓ أُخْرَىٰ
words: أَسْكِنُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ سَكَنتُم مِّن وُجْدِكُمْ
وَلَا تُضَآرُّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُوا۟ عَلَيْهِنَّ ۚ وَإِن كُنَّ
scramble.verseEn: Lodge them [in a section] of where you dwell out of your means and do not harm them in order to oppress them. And if they should be pregnant, then spend on them until they give birth. And if they breastfeed for you, then give them their payment and confer among yourselves in the acceptable way; but if you are in discord, then there may breastfeed for him [i.e., the father] another woman.
